integrity: The statement is supported by an analytic proof and a standalone finite exact-integer checker; finite checks are not a proof of general quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Requires strictly positive personalized two-tier additive valuations and complete EFX allocations.
Does not prove EFX existence, apply to chores, or apply to arbitrary multi-valued goods.
Priority remains uncertain for the inaccessible full manuscript arXiv:2608.15822.
The sharpness counterexample type was previously known in EFX/MMS literature.
title: The sharp two-items-per-agent boundary for EFX to imply maximin shares under positive bivalued valuations
